# Tensile test of Al single crystal

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Define crystal structure
read_data Al.data

pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al_Zhou.eam.alloy Al

# Define compute
compute stress all stress/atom NULL
compute pe all pe/atom

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Create velocity and fix temperature
velocity all create 300.0 12345 rot yes dist gaussian

# Equilibration
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press pxx pyy pzz pe lx ly lz

# Run equilibration
run 20000
unfix 1

# Setup for tensile deformation
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 y 0.0 0.0 1.0 z 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix 2 all deform 1 x erate 0.01 units box

# Output settings

variable L0 equal ${lx}
variable stress_xx equal "pxx/10000" # Convert to GPa
variable stress_yy equal "pyy/10000"
variable stress_zz equal "pzz/10000"

# Dump commands
dump 1 all custom 100 dump.tensile id type x y z
dump_modify 1 sort id
fix print all print 100 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Run deformation
run 20000
